title: Stale exact-source runtime subject must not promote newer repository generations
falsifier_hypothesis: A successful target-runtime execution of cfe3f1ee4766deb827a7e7adb87fd25b3f89e809 proves only that exact historical integrated subject. It cannot promote current-main WP206/WP901 successor generations or a later release candidate unless those exact newer semantics are source-bound into and executed by a fresh runtime probe.
counterhypothesis: The newer generations are semantically irrelevant to the exercised boundary, so the historical runtime receipt could remain sufficient for a narrowly defined unchanged sub-boundary.

required_before_promotion: Compare the successful runtime subject tree against the candidate promotion subject tree.
Enumerate all newer commits touching WP206/WP901 code, schemas, authority binding, persistence/recovery predicates, tests or receipt identity on the exercised path.
If any such semantic delta exists, runtime credit remains bound to the historical subject and current-generation runtime credit stays zero until exact-source replay.

If no semantic delta touches the exercised boundary, only the explicitly unchanged sub-boundary may inherit evidence, with the invariance proof recorded; whole-path/current-head promotion remains forbidden by default.
discriminator.hard_negative: A green queued-or-later-completed run for cfe3f1... plus green repository CI for newer WP206/WP901 generations is not composable into current target-runtime credit without an explicit invariance proof or exact-source replay.

epistemic_boundary: Queued jobs are not runtime evidence.
Completed historical-subject runtime is not current-head runtime by implication.
Repository CI of successor generations cannot bridge the runtime subject gap.
This packet grants no mutation authority and mints no credit.
next_exact_action: When the existing self-hosted runtime job completes, bind its receipt strictly to cfe3f1...; then either prove exercised-boundary semantic invariance across newer WP206/WP901 deltas or dispatch exactly one deduplicated exact-source replay for the current accepted successor subject.
